d: Lok aastha ke mahaparv chhath puja ke chauthe aur antim din kendriy mantri va lok janshakti parti (ram vilas) ke rashtriy adhyaksh chirag pasvan ne apne parivar ke sath udiyman sury ko usha arghy arpit kiya. puja-archana ke bad unhonne deshvasiyon aur biharvasiyon ko chhath ki shubhkamnaen din tatha MNS pramukh raj thakre ke bayan par karara palatvar kiya.
